subject: PillarHealth assurance orchestration: SOC 2, pen-test window & evidence owners
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@pillarhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PillarHealth security exhibit: SOC2/pen-test rhythm & evidence owners

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of procurement we need to lock down a couple of items in the MSA/order form security exhibit so the legal and InfoSec teams can sign off:

- SOC 2: we need confirmation of the scope (in-scope services & controls) and expected attestation date for the next 12 months.
- Pen test: what access can Redwood provide for a third-party test (staging IPs, timeboxed windows, credentialing), and will Redwood require an NDA or specific scoping constraints?
- Evidence cadence: we prefer a monthly artifact bundle with a defined sample list (logs, ACL screenshots, configuration exports). Can you share a minimal artifact manifest?
- Inspection window: can you support a limited on-site/remote inspection (2 business days) and a rotation plan for evidence ownership?

Attached is our security requirements doc (PH-Security-Reqs-v1.pdf) — it's fairly prescriptive. We don't expect all items to be accepted as-is, but we need a clear path for the order form appendix and any redlines to the MSA.

Request: can you propose an assurance orchestration plan and a tentative pen-test window (Aug–Sep preferred)? We have procurement deadlines on Aug 24, so aim to finalize language by Aug 20.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Compliance | PillarHealth
elena.soto@pillarhealth.com

Attachment: PH-Security-Reqs-v1.pdf (15 pages, checklist + manifest)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@pillarhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PillarHealth security exhibit: SOC2/pen-test rhythm & evidence owners

Elena —

Appreciate the level of detail. Quick plan from our side:

1) Sync: propose a 30-min technical + legal sync this week to align scope and owners (we have availability Wed/Fri afternoon PT).
2) Evidence cadence: we can produce a monthly artifact bundle for a rolling 90-day window. I'll attach an initial outline of what we can reasonably deliver (logs, snapshot configs, access lists, SOC2 report metadata). Expect the bundle to be delivered via an encrypted S3 share.
3) Pen test: Redwood supports timeboxed external pen tests against a staging environment. Options: a) single 3-day window in staging, b) two 2-day windows (pre-prod + post-patch). We'll need the tester's IP ranges, tester contact, and a short scoping statement. We can require a brief NDA and an attestation that no production data will be imported into staging.
4) Order form/MSA: I'll loop in Laura to propose precise exhibit language and an appendix that maps our artifact manifest to PillarHealth's checklist.

Next steps: Laura — can you draft suggested MSA exhibit text (audit rights + pen-test clause + evidence cadence) for a single-canopy appendix? Marcus — can you confirm the minimal artifact manifest and whether we can deliver exports via the S3 share or a secure transfer? Elena — please confirm which pen-test option you'd prefer and your recommended dates.

I've attached a short assurance outline to speed the sync.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: assurance-outline.md (outline of monthly bundle + transfer mechanics)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@pillarhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PillarHealth security exhibit: SOC2/pen-test rhythm & evidence owners

Karthik / Elena —

Thanks — I'm attaching a draft redline for the MSA exhibit and a proposed order-form appendix that covers:

- Audit rights: limited inspection (remote) with 48 hours notice; scope limited to systems that process PillarHealth data as defined in Section 2.1.
- SOC 2: acceptance of Redwood's annual Type II attestation for the defined services; if an interim report is required, we'll provide the SOC2 bridge summary.
- Pen testing: allowed against non-prod environments only; external testers must be on-boarded, provide IP lists, and sign Redwood's testing NDA. Pen test findings follow the standard severity-to-remediation timeline in Exhibit B; Redwood will provide evidence of remediation for critical findings within 30 days.
- Evidence cadence & delivery: monthly artifact bundle (encrypted S3 link) + quarterly snapshot for archive; acceptance criteria and the manifest are in Appendix A.

I've kept language narrow and operationally realistic to avoid wide legal pushback. Please review the redline and suggest edits. If PillarHealth needs broader on-site inspection rights we can discuss a scoped amendment, but our preference is remote evidence transfer + a scheduled read-only session with engineering.

If this looks reasonable, I can convert to tracked changes on the MSA and share a single tracked file for both sides to redline.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-msaword-redlines.docx (MSA exhibit + order form appendix — redline)

Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PillarHealth security exhibit: SOC2/pen-test rhythm & evidence owners

Laura / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the focused language. A few clarifications:

- The SOC 2 acceptance is fine but we do need confirmation of the control mappings for data retention and encryption-at-rest. Can you send the mapping matrix?
- Pen test: PillarHealth will take option (b) — two 2-day windows. Proposed tester: Redline Labs (redlinelabs@testers.com). We'll share IPs and statement of work by EOD.
- Evidence: monthly bundle is acceptable; please ensure the manifest includes: auth logs (7-day retention snapshot), config backups (exported JSON), ACL screenshots (VPC/role lists), and a list of deployed model versions in scope.

I'll schedule the sync for Thursday 11:30am PT (invitation coming). If you can convert Laura's redline into tracked changes, we'll circulate to procurement/legal for an expedited sign-off.

Best,
Elena
Head of Compliance | PillarHealth
